risks.name: Fire from cooking and baking equipment
risks.reason: The bakery uses gas ovens and fryers every day, which can start a fire.

risks.name: Equipment breakdown
risks.reason: Production depends on ovens and mixers; a breakdown stops baking.

risks.name: Theft, burglary and vandalism
risks.reason: The shop keeps cash, stock and equipment on the premises overnight.

risks.name: Payment fraud and chargebacks
risks.reason: The business accepts card payments, which can be targeted by fraud.

risks.name: Flood, storm and water damage
risks.reason: The premises are in an area that floods during the monsoon season.

risks.name: Forced closure after premises damage
risks.reason: If the premises are damaged, the bakery cannot trade and loses income.

assessments.risk_name: Fire from cooking and baking equipment
assessments.reason: Section 1 covers fire damage, including fire from cooking or baking equipment.

evidence.text: The insurer will indemnify the insured against physical loss of or damage to the property described in the schedule caused by fire, including fire arising from cooking or baking equipment used at the premises.

assessments.reason: No policy wording about equipment or machinery breakdown was retrieved.
Theft is covered only when it follows forcible and violent entry into the premises.

evidence.text: The insurer will indemnify the insured for loss of contents by theft only where the theft follows forcible and violent entry into or exit from the premises. Theft without signs of forcible entry is subject to the conditions stated in the schedule.

assessments.reason: No policy wording about payment fraud or cyber risks was retrieved.
The general exclusions remove flood and storm surge damage unless a flood extension is shown.

evidence.text: This policy does not cover loss or damage caused by flood, inundation, storm surge or the overflow of any river, canal or drain, unless an extension for flood is shown in the schedule.

assessments.reason: An extension mentions loss of gross profit, but only where stated in the schedule, which was not provided.

evidence.text: Where stated in the schedule, the insurer may consider loss of gross profit following interruption of the business at the premises. The indemnity period and sum insured for this extension are as shown in the schedule.
